answer_1.quote: In recent years, there has been significant development in neural machine translation (NMT).

answer_2.quote: We introduce several end-to-end evaluation metrics for IMT systems that provide more accurate measures of the total cost of the entire iterative collaboration process.

answer_4.quote: we ask three human translators to interact with IMT systems.
answer_4.guideline: Translators use flexible operations (such as keep, insert, replace, delete, and blank-filling) to interact with IMT models without any requirements. We provide a "MTPE" checkbox that the user could click to express their dissatisfaction with the interactive process.
